task: If I start using Copilot Individual, how much US dollars will it cost per year and what features does it have?
answer: GitHub Copilot Individual (the personal plan, now named 'Copilot Pro' on GitHub's Plans & pricing page) costs $10 USD per month; the page offers no separate annual billing option, so using it for a year costs $10 x 12 = $120 USD per year. Features included with the individual (Pro) plan: everything in the Free plan plus access to the Cloud agent and code review, unlimited code completion and next edit suggestions, access to 3rd-party agents (Claude Code and Codex), model selection, and $15 monthly total credits for Pro.
